'''Magva Yarro''' was a [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman]] [[human]] who took part in the peaceful protest against the [[Galactic Empire]] on her [[homeworld]] of [[Ghorman]] before the regime began [[Ghorman Massacre|slaughtering]] the protesters in [[2 BBY]]. After surviving the massacre, she joined the [[Partisans]], a militia group led by the resistance fighter [[Saw Gerrera]], and fought against the Empire, operating as a forward spotter for their [[Cavern Angels]] [[squadron]].

While on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] in [[1 BBY]], she was among the group of Partisans who escorted [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Jyn Erso]], [[K-2SO]], and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and the [[Guardians of the Whills]] [[Chirrut Îmwe]] and [[Baze Malbus]] to the [[Catacombs of Cadera]]. Yarro was present there shortly before [[Jedha City]] was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]], which caused a shockwave that [[Death|killed]] Gerrera and several Partisans.

==Biography==
Hailing from the<ref name="Geektionary English" /> [[Colonies]]<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> [[planet]] [[Ghorman]],<ref name="Geektionary English" /> Magva Yarro participated in the peaceful protest on her [[homeworld]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Geektionary" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> the Empire initiated the [[Ghorman Massacre]], in which they [[Death|killed]] several protesters. Being one of the few survivors, Yarro saw the true nature of the Empire and decided to search for a faction that opposed it.<ref name="Geektionary" />

Rejecting the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] led by<ref name="Geektionary" /> former Imperial [[senator]]<ref name="ROUVG" /> [[Mon Mothma]], she instead joined up with an extremist militia group, the [[Partisans]], that was led by the resistance fighter [[Saw Gerrera]] to combat the Empire.<ref name="Geektionary" /> She became a forward spotter for their [[Cavern Angels]] [[X-wing starfighter]] [[squadron]].<ref name="ROUVG" /> At one point, she [[pilot]]ed a [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]]<ref name="Magva Yarro U-Wing">{{FFGXW|set=Saw's Renegades Expansion Pack|cardname=Magva Yarro|ship=U-wing}}</ref> over the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]<ref name="ROUVG" /> while the [[gunner]] fired the [[Starship|ship's]] mounted weapon.<ref name="Magva Yarro U-Wing" /> At another point, she participated in a firefight around a structure.<ref name="Magva Yarro Crew">{{FFGXW|set=Saw's Renegades Expansion Pack|cardname=Magva Yarro (Crew)}}</ref>

[[File:Magva_Yarro_mini_game.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Yarro joined the Partisans after surviving the Ghorman Massacre.]]
While on Jedha<ref name="RO" /> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which include the events on [[Jedha]] and Yarro's appearance in the film, to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Yarro and a group of Partisans escorted Rebel Alliance members [[Jyn Erso]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], and [[K-2SO]] along with [[Guardians of the Whills]] [[Chirrut Îmwe]] and [[Baze Malbus]] following their [[Battle on Jedha|capture]] in [[Jedha City]] to the [[Catacombs of Cadera]], where the Partisans' base was located. During the journey, she personally escorted Malbus. Later, at the base, Yarro<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> nonchalantly looked at Erso<ref name="Geektionary" /> while the girl was escorted to Gerrera. Shortly after, the Empire had their [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|obliterate]] Jedha City, creating a large shockwave. Although the base was hastily evacuated, Gerrera<ref name="RO" /> and several Partisans were killed in the event.<ref name="Inferno Squad">''[[Battlefront II: Inferno Squad]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Magva_Yarro_U-wing_SR_Darren_Tan.png|thumb|right|300px|Yarro pilots a U-wing.]]
Magva Yarro was initially a naive idealist who believed that the Galactic Empire could be combatted through non-violent means. After living through the Ghorman Massacre, she experienced a psychological reaction that caused her to look for the fiercest group fighting the Empire.<ref name="Geektionary" />

Yarro avoided Mon Mothma's Rebel Alliance as she viewed its members as ineffective cowards<ref name="ROUVG" /> and thought Mothma was not fierce enough,<ref name="Geektionary" /> despite the fact that the former senator openly condemned the Ghorman Massacre and denounced the Empire prior defecting from the [[Imperial Senate]] and [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|forming]] the Alliance.<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref> As a member of the Partisans, Yarro showed strong loyalty to the group.<ref name="FFGweb">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2018/6/5/extreme-action|text=Extreme Action}}</ref> A [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> [[human]], Yarro had light skin and wore dark face paint around her [[eye]]s.<ref name="ROUVG" />

==Equipment==
Along with several equipment pouches around her chest and a device on her head, Magva Yarro wore a dark [[Clothing|coat]] with [[Color|red]] accents as well as dark pants. She was equipped with a modified [[DH-17 blaster rifle]] and carried multiple cylinders on her back.<ref name="ROUVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Magva Yarro first appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|anthology]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="RO" /> She was identified in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="ROUVG" /> The character was portrayed by [[Sabine Crossen]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|sabinecrossen|status/887937042835005440|[[Sabine Crossen]]|archivedate=20210314075259}}</ref> The Jedha desert scenes were filmed at [[Wikipedia:Wadi Rum|Wadi Rum]], [[Wikipedia:Jordan|Jordan]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Jordan Times">{{WebCite|url=http://www.jordantimes.com/news/local/rfc-bags-outstanding-film-commission%E2%80%99-award|text=RFC bags 'Outstanding Film Commission' Award|date=2017-04-10|work=[[Wikipedia:The Jordan Times|The Jordan Times]]|quote=The RFC earned this award for the American science fiction film "Rogue One: A Star Wars Story", directed by Gareth Edwards, that was shot in Wadi Rum in 2015, the statement said.|archivedate=20191015052241}}</ref>
